title: 跪坐向前伸一点
description: 成人跪坐垫上，双手前伸，背部放松，不追求极限。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult kneels on a thick mat and gently reaches both hands forward, hips resting only as far back as comfortable.
